Claude.description: Anthropic's Claude model family (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable) and the Claude.ai Pro/Max subscriptions that also cover Claude Code usage.

ChatGPT / Codex.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT subscriptions (Plus $20/mo, Pro $200/mo), which also include usage of the Codex coding agent and OpenAI's GPT models.

DeepSeek.description: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek's models (e.g. DeepSeek 4.1 and its Flash variant), used via its low-cost pay-per-token API or third-party providers.

OpenCode Go/Zen.description: OpenCode's model-access offerings: Go, a $10/month subscription for open coding models (GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, etc.), and Zen (now the OpenCode Console), a pay-as-you-go prepaid-credit model gateway.

Custom assistant.description: Bucket for self-built personal assistant agents and bots (e.g. cron-started agent sessions, custom daemons, stock-simulation bots) rather than a specific product.

OpenClaw.description: Open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent (formerly Clawdbot/Moltbot) created by Peter Steinberger that connects chat apps like WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal to an LLM agent that can run tasks.
OpenClaw.vendor: OpenClaw (open-source foundation; created by Peter Steinberger)

Gemini.description: Google's Gemini models and Google AI subscriptions (AI Pro/Ultra, also bundled in Workspace plans) that include the Gemini app, Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage.

Grok bot.description: xAI's Grok Bot, an always-on agent (beta from August 2026) that runs on its own cloud computer, connects to your apps and performs multi-step tasks; available with SuperGrok plans and via macOS/iOS apps.

Kimi.description: Moonshot AI's Kimi models (e.g. Kimi K-series) and Kimi subscriptions/API, also widely available through providers like OpenRouter.

Z.ai (GLM).description: Z.ai (Zhipu AI) and its GLM model family, offered through the GLM Coding Plan subscriptions (Lite/Pro/Max) and API.

Dots.description: OpenAI's dots, always-on agents in ChatGPT (launched at DevDay, September 2026) that have their own cloud computer and memory, connect to your apps, and can own projects and multi-step tasks.

Ollama Cloud.description: Ollama's hosted cloud model service (Free/Pro/Max plans on ollama.com) for running large open models such as GLM and DeepSeek through the Ollama API and app.

Melious.description: Melious, a Saarbrücken, Germany-based AI inference platform that serves open-weight models through an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, routing only to European hosting partners, with pay-per-token pricing.

Mistral.description: Mistral AI's Le Chat subscriptions (Pro ~$14.99/mo) and model access from the French AI lab Mistral.

Perplexity.description: Perplexity's AI answer engine and its Pro/Max subscriptions, which include multi-model access and the Perplexity Computer agent.

Instinct.description: Instinct, an invite-only personal AI agent that you text over iMessage/SMS to handle errands like bookings, email and planning, with its own email address and group-chat support.

NanoClaw.description: Lightweight open-source alternative to OpenClaw that runs agents in isolated containers on the Claude Agent SDK and connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and other messengers.

Duet.description: Claude Duet, Anthropic's proactive always-on agent app (research preview from October 2026, waitlist invitations for US Pro/Max users) that monitors connected apps and works on tasks in the background.

OpenBot.description: Open-source, self-hosted platform for running a team of AI bots with tools, long-term memory and persistent inboxes in shared threads; created by GitHub user regnull as an open alternative to Grok Bot.

Osaurus.description: Osaurus, an open-source native macOS (Apple Silicon) app for running local and cloud AI models with agents, memory and tools on your Mac.

Letta.description: Letta (formerly MemGPT), an open-source platform and cloud service for building stateful agents with long-term memory.

Rakazo.description: Rakazo, an open-source (Apache 2.0) self-hosted platform for persistent AI bots that sign into your tools and complete tasks with sandboxed browser/shell, memory and routines; built by Inbox Zero as an open alternative to Grok Bot.

Command Code.description: Command Code, a terminal-first AI coding agent from Langbase with low-cost model plans; GOAT is its $10/month tier with credits across many open and closed coding models.

Agenta.description: Agenta, an open-source LLMOps platform for prompt management, evaluation and observability of LLM applications; the commenter's own product.

Kagi.description: Kagi, a paid ad-free search engine; the Ultimate plan adds the Kagi Assistant with access to multiple LLMs.

Nous Research.description: Nous Research's Nous Portal subscription (Plus ~$20/month in credits) giving access to its Hermes models and hundreds of other models, used with the Hermes Agent.

Claude Cowork.description: Claude Cowork, Anthropic's agent mode in the Claude desktop app (launched January 2026) that works on local files and connected apps to complete non-coding tasks.

Other providers.description: Bucket for unspecified subscriptions to cheaper tiers of various other model providers.

Pickle.description: Likely Pickle (getpickle.ai), a startup offering AI clones/personal AI you can talk to, which the commenter uses to make calls while driving; exact product unverified.

Meta AI.description: Meta's Meta AI assistant and its paid AI subscription tiers (introduced 2026 under the Meta One brand, $7.99/$19.99 per month).

OpenSWE.description: Open SWE, LangChain's open-source framework for internal asynchronous coding agents, built on LangGraph/Deep Agents and invokable from Slack or GitHub to open PRs.

Xiaomi MiMo.description: Xiaomi's MiMo model family (e.g. MiMo-V2.5/V2.6 Pro) and its Token Plan subscriptions for use in coding tools.

Charm Hyper.description: Hyper, Charm's model inference service for coding (initially private beta), usable from Charm's Crush terminal agent or other tools.

Synthetic.description: Synthetic (synthetic.new), a subscription/pay-per-use provider hosting open models (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen) for coding agents.

Comet.description: Comet, Perplexity's AI-powered web browser with a built-in agent that can browse and act on websites for the user.

NBClaw.description: NBClaw, a small Python daemon (on PyPI) that puts a Swival agent behind a Signal conversation via signal-cli, giving an OpenClaw-like assistant that can run shell commands and edit files.

exe.dev.description: exe.dev, a subscription service for fast persistent Linux cloud VMs for developers and coding agents, with a built-in web coding agent (Shelley).

Claude Desktop.description: Anthropic's Claude desktop app (macOS/Windows) with MCP connectors, used by the commenter as an agent platform.

Vantegrate.description: Unidentified; per the comment, a tool/platform used to run production agents on Salesforce.

LongCat.description: Meituan's LongCat model family (e.g. LongCat-Flash, LongCat 2.0), available via Meituan's API and third-party providers.
